national_news.title: Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Train Flagged Off
bullets: Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw flagged off the 16-coach Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Train at Sir M. Visvesvaraya Terminal in Bengaluru.
The train will run 6 days a week, covering the journey in approximately 16 hours across key halts including Kalaburagi, Solapur, Pune, and Kalyan.
The government approved the South Corridor bullet train route connecting Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Amravati, and Chennai, aimed at reducing Bengaluru-Chennai travel time to 73 minutes.

national_news.title: Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao Drive Raises Child Sex Ratio to 915
bullets: Addressing Haryana Day celebrations, President Droupadi Murmu highlighted that the Child Sex Ratio at birth improved from 871 (2014) to around 915 in November 2025 under Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao (launched Jan 2015).
Haryana contributes approximately 3.6% to India's GDP and stands as the first state in the country to procure 24 crops at Minimum Support Price (MSP).
The event commemorated the 60th anniversary of the formation of Haryana as a state.

national_news.title: SEBI Introduces AI Tool 'Sudarshan' and New Measures Against Financial Fraud
bullets: SEBI has developed an AI-based tool named 'Sudarshan' featuring a 5-stage checking process to detect financial market violations across social media platforms.
The regulator introduced verified badges on Google Play Store for genuine apps, launched SCORES 2.0 portal for complaint redressal, and created a WhatsApp awareness channel in 11 regional languages.
SEBI Saarthi App and SEBI Check facilities were highlighted to assist investors in account verification prior to market transactions.

national_news.title: Vice President Inaugurates National Organ Transplant Games 2026
bullets: Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan inaugurated the National Organ Transplant Games 2026 at Talkatora Stadium, New Delhi.
A World Record was created by 570 transplant recipients and donors performing Tadasana together, certified by the World Book of Records.
The Vice President released the 'Zindagi Dobara' Calendar and felicitated medal winners of the World Transplant Games 2025 held in Dresden, Germany.

national_news.title: Centre Forms High-Level Committee on Banking Reforms for Viksit Bharat 2047
bullets: The Ministry of Finance constituted a High-Level Committee on Banking with a six-month tenure to recommend structural, regulatory, and legislative reforms for the banking sector.
The committee is chaired by former Central Vigilance Commissioner Suresh N. Patel, with RBI Deputy Governor Shirish Chandra Murmu, Padmaja Chunduru, and N. S. Vishwanathan as members.
The panel will assess existing banking norms, evaluate governance in RRBs and Cooperative Banks, and prepare a roadmap for AI adoption and cybersecurity safeguards.

national_news.title: Union Government Releases ₹1.09 Lakh Crore Additional Tax Devolution to States
bullets: The Ministry of Finance released an advance instalment of tax devolution amounting to ₹1,09,019 crore to State Governments to accelerate capital spending and welfare expenditure.
This marks the second additional tax devolution instalment released by the Central Government in the current financial year.
Among the states, Uttar Pradesh received the highest allocation of ₹19,208 crore, followed by Bihar at ₹10,845 crore.

national_news.title: BEML Builds India's First Indigenous Bullet Train B28 in Bengaluru
bullets: Bharat Earth Movers Limited (BEML), in collaboration with the Integral Coach Factory (ICF), is manufacturing India's first indigenous bullet train set named 'B28' at its Aditya complex in Bengaluru.
The B28 high-speed train is designed for a maximum speed of 350 km/h with an operational speed of 320 km/h, intended for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail corridor.
The train coach body successfully completed the mandatory squeeze test, which tests the structural integrity of coaches against high-speed aerodynamic vacuum pressures.

national_news.title: EPFO Celebrates 74th Foundation Day in New Delhi
bullets: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) marked its 74th Foundation Day at Dr. Ambedkar International Centre, New Delhi.
Union Minister for Labour & Employment Mansukh Mandaviya stated that EPFO manages an accumulated corpus of ₹32 lakh crore through contributions from over 8 crore active members.
The institution highlighted technological transformation initiatives like CITES 2.01 to enhance social security delivery for organized and unorganized sector workers.

national_news.title: President Droupadi Murmu Inaugurates Simhastha Kumbh Mela in Nashik
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu inaugurated the Simhastha Kumbh Mela in Nashik, becoming the first Indian President to hoist the flag at the event.
During the event, the President released the Kumbh Mela anthem 'Har Har Gange' composed by Ajay-Atul, an official website, and a special postage stamp.
The event emphasizes social harmony, cultural preservation, and long-term urban infrastructure transformation in Nashik and Trimbakeshwar.

bihar_news.title: Disqualification Row Over Bihar Independent MLCs Under Tenth Schedule
bullets: Opposition leaders in Bihar announced plans to approach the Legislative Council Chairman and court seeking disqualification of independent MLCs Bansidhar Brijwasi (Tirhut Graduates) and Rahul Raj (Saran Teachers) after they initially joined the BJP.

The disqualification demand invokes Article 191(2) and the Tenth Schedule of the Constitution, under which an independently elected legislator faces disqualification if they join any political party post-election.
Following legal objections, party leaders clarified that the independent MLCs only extended external support to the party without taking formal membership.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Makhana Exports Reach 7,265 Tonnes in FY 2025-26
bullets: Bihar's makhana (fox nut) exports reached 7,264.89 tonnes in FY 2025-26, with the US, Canada, and UAE accounting for approximately 77% of total shipments.
Bihar accounts for 85% to 90% of India's makhana production, with total cultivation covering 35,224 hectares across Mithilanchal, Seemanchal, and Kosi regions.
High-yielding varieties like Sabour Makhana-1 yield 32–35 quintals per hectare with a 55–60% pop recovery rate, with Katihar and Purnea emerging as leading producing districts.

bihar_news.title: TEA Global Experience Index Ranks Palace Museum as World's Most Visited
bullets: The Themed Entertainment Association (TEA) published the 2025 Global Experience Index, recording 161.4 million total visits across the world's top 20 museums in 2025, a 5.4% increase from 2024.
China's Palace Museum (Forbidden City) in Beijing ranked as the most visited museum globally with 19 million visitors, followed by the Summer Palace (17.38 million).
France's Louvre Museum ranked 4th globally with 9.05 million visitors, while the Vatican Museums and UK's Natural History Museum also featured in the top 10 list.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Announces Tallest Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Statue in Patna
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced the state government's decision to install Bihar's tallest statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel in Patna.
The announcement was made during a Rashtriya Ekta Diwas event at Bapu Sabhagar in Patna to honour Patel's legacy.
The proposed monument will be the largest statue among all eminent personalities established in the state, commemorating Sardar Patel's role in integrating over 560 princely states into India.
